Voyager 1 was launched by NASA on September 5, 1977 from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. Voyager 2 was launched slightly earlier, on August 20, 1977. Both spacecraft carry the Golden Record, a phonograph record containing sounds and images selected to portray the diversity of life and culture on Earth. Voyager 1 crossed the heliopause and entered interstellar space on August 25, 2012, becoming the first human-made object to reach interstellar space. The Voyager probes are powered by radioisotope thermoelectric generators that convert heat from the radioactive decay of plutonium-238 into electricity.
